newsitem.title: USA: INSIGHT - PepsiCo bounces past support.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - PepsiCo bounces past support.

text.p: PepsiCo Inc shares gained in heavy mid-afternoon trading with value investors continuing to accumulate the stock that had dropped near the $28 level.
Pepsi stock rose 3/4 to 29-1/2, with about 7.1 million shares traded. Pepsi has been on the NYSE most active list for several days.
Technicians said the stock appeared to have broken away from the $28 support and was headed to the next level of $31.
The stock began moving down in late August, dropping to about 28-1/2 on August 29, several days after news that Coca-Cola Co made a deal with Venezuela's largest bottler.
The last time Pepsi shares had closed below $29 was on January 22, when it finished at about 28-7/8.
"I suspect there's some bottom fishing going on," said Frank Calta, head of trading at Anvil Institutional Services.
"A lot of the action is since the Venezuela thing," said Kevin Haggerty, a trader at Fidelity Investments. "That's when the stock started to sell down."
"Now the value guys are saying the stock's been knocked down for the wrong reasons, and a lot of people have jumped in, and picked it up at the 28-1/2 level."
"The stock has been in play," agreed Calta. "It's been used as a source of funds (by institutions) in recent weeks. You may now see some institutions putting some money to work in the stock."
Calta said the stock is viewed as more of a defensive-type stock, part food company, part soft-drink company.
Technically, the stock "has held off the bounce at $28 nicely," said Peter Green at Gruntal & Co.

He cautioned that the stock is still considered in a downtrend, and would have to hit $31 to break that trend and move toward the late-June intraday peak of near $36. He identified the resistance at about $34-$35.

"In order to make $35, it needs to touch $31," Green said. "It's an important figure basis, but that may take time. It may have to back and fill before making the attempt at $31." He said the stock may reach $31 in about four weeks.
